title: First-order methods for stochastic and finite-sum convex optimization with deterministic constraints
abstract: arXiv:2506.20630v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we study a class of stochastic and finite-sum convex optimization problems with deterministic constraints. Existing methods typically aim to find an $\epsilon$-$expected\ feasible\ stochastic\ optimal$ solution, in which both the expected constraint violation and the expected optimality gap are within a prescribed tolerance $\epsilon$. However, in many practical applications, constraints must be nearly satisfied with certainty, rendering such solutions potentially unsuitable due to the risk of substantial violations. To address this issue, we propose stochastic first-order methods for finding an $\epsilon$-$surely\ feasible\ stochastic\ optimal$ ($\epsilon$-SFSO) solution, where the constraint violation is deterministically bounded by $\epsilon$ and the expected optimality gap is at most $\epsilon$. Our methods apply an accelerated stochastic gradient (ASG) scheme or a modified variance-reduced ASG scheme $only\

translated_title: 确定性约束下随机与有限和凸优化的一阶方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究了一类具有确定性约束的随机与有限和凸优化问题。现有方法通常旨在寻找ε-期望可行随机最优（ε-expected feasible stochastic optimal）解，其中期望约束违反与期望最优性间隙均不超过给定的容忍度ε。然而，在许多实际应用中，约束必须几乎以确定性方式得到满足，这使得此类解由于存在严重违反约束的风险而可能不再适用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了随机一阶方法来寻找ε-确定可行随机最优（ε-SFSO）解，其中约束违反被确定性地限制在ε以内，且期望最优性间隙至多为ε。我们的方法采用加速随机梯度（ASG）方案或改进的方差缩减ASG方案……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了针对确定性约束下随机与有限和凸优化的随机一阶方法，能够找到约束违反被确定性界定且期望最优性间隙不超过ε的ε-确定可行随机最优（ε-SFSO）解，克服了以往期望可行解可能存在严重约束违反的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes stochastic first-order methods for stochastic and finite-sum convex optimization with deterministic constraints, which find ε-surely feasible stochastic optimal (ε-SFSO) solutions where the constraint violation is deterministically bounded by ε and the expected optimality gap is at most ε, addressing the risk of substantial constraint violations inherent in existing expected-feasibility approaches.
